name: Optical Engineering
boundaries: Optical Engineering: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Perfect broadband, omnidirectional visible invisibility cloak
original_dispositions.reason: Passive cloaking over a nonzero bandwidth is bounded by causality and passivity (https://doi.org/10.1364/OPTICA.3.000718; https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevA.110.063513). The zero-scatter, all-visible-wavelength, all-direction specification conflicts with those bounds. Seeing through tissue is OPT-05.

original_dispositions.original_title: Achromatic metalens with near-100 percent efficiency across the visible
original_dispositions.reason: Imaging with lenses already exists. Presutti and Monticone’s bandwidth–delay bound limits the broadband high-NA flat lens (https://doi.org/10.1364/OPTICA.389404). The far-field super-resolution problem, which is a different concept, remains OPT-06.

original_dispositions.original_title: Deterministic room-temperature on-chip single-photon source with near-unity indistinguishability
original_dispositions.reason: The room-temperature constraint is now stated inside that entry. Opened room-temperature results reach partial interference or high purity, not the joint efficiency and indistinguishability of the cryogenic quantum-dot source, and not an array.

original_dispositions.original_title: Practical all-optical transistor with gain and cascadability
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by OPT-01. The thousandfold energy claim and the end of the interconnect bottleneck are not part of that concept. Link energy is OPT-09. Miller’s criteria and the CMOS energy comparison stay the proposed scope.

original_dispositions.original_title: Real-time perfect adaptive optics at any aperture and wavelength
original_dispositions.reason: Astronomical adaptive optics is already practiced. Strong scattering in living tissue is OPT-05. Large electronic apertures are OPT-07. The unlimited wording does not identify a further single principle.

original_dispositions.original_title: Hollow-core fiber below 0.01 dB/km with zero dispersion and zero nonlinearity from the ultraviolet to the mid-infrared
original_dispositions.reason: Loss below the silica floor is already measured at 0.091 dB/km over a wide telecom band (https://doi.org/10.1038/s41566-025-01747-5). The remaining multi-band, zero-dispersion, zero-nonlinearity specification is a harder fiber target on top of an achieved guiding principle.

original_dispositions.original_title: Dynamic volumetric holographic display with full parallax, occlusion, and retinal resolution
original_dispositions.reason: The controllable space–bandwidth product is OPT-07. A 2024 étendue expander and existing light-field and varifocal displays already occupy parts of the display problem. The retinal-resolution, any-angle video system remains a larger instance of OPT-07, not a separate optical principle.

original_dispositions.original_title: Passive magnet-free isolator and circulator above 60 dB, broadband, with no active drive
original_dispositions.reason: Magnet-free integrated isolators have been demonstrated with acousto-optic or electro-optic drive, at about 25–30 dB (https://doi.org/10.1038/s41566-025-01663-8; https://doi.org/10.1038/s41566-026-01978-0). The opened devices use modulation. The passive, drive-free, all-wavelength specification is a reciprocity problem, and the demonstrated function is already in hand at lower isolation.

original_dispositions.original_title: Self-healing optical materials that fully restore performance after laser or mechanical damage
original_dispositions.reason: Jeong et al. restored a scratched transparent polymer coating with near-infrared heating (https://doi.org/10.1021/acsami.2c21058). That is scratch repair of a vision-system coating. Full restoration of a laser optic after ablation was not shown in an opened primary paper. The result is materials durability of existing optics.

original_dispositions.original_title: Photonic neural-network hardware at brain-like energy and exascale, including the stated figure above 10¹⁸ operations per second per watt
original_dispositions.reason: That numerical figure was not found in an opened source. Shekhar et al. name scaling, memory, and insertion loss as the photonic-computing challenges (https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-024-44750-0). The missing nonlinearity and cascadability are OPT-01. The missing link energy is OPT-09.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Initial list, 1 November 2026: OPT-01 through OPT-10 were kept.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Isolators, sub-silica hollow-core fiber, petabit discs, metalens replacement of glass, fusion-driver scaling, clock miniaturization, and standalone holographic video were left off as achieved in principle, overlapping, or below the calibration bar.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Reconciliation pass, 1 November 2026: No ID was deleted, replaced, or merged. No OPT-11 or later ID was assigned.
OPT-02 was amended. Room-temperature nanotube, boron-nitride, and gallium-nitride sources are now in the current state, with the indistinguishability and efficiency gap stated from the opened papers.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The completion criterion remains the loss-threshold array. Room temperature is recorded as an additional proposed accessibility scope, matching historical item 3, rather than as a new concept.

reconciliation_change_log.change: OPT-01, OPT-05, OPT-07, and OPT-09 received short overlap flags.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical “1000× energy” and “ends the interconnect bottleneck” wording is explicitly separated from the transistor and assigned, where it belongs, to the full-link energy of OPT-09.

reconciliation_change_log.change: OPT-07’s current state now includes the 7 May 2026 APL Photonics phased-array perspective.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Its author list and DOI were not on the retrieved sections.
